Academic Support

  • Home
  • Academics
  • Academic Support

Guidance for your journey to graduation.

We know that personalized academic advising is key to navigating your college studies. That's why at Cal Lutheran, we'll work closely with you to develop your academic goals and create a path from your first class to your last.

As an undergraduate student, you'll have access to your own faculty mentor, academic adviser and peer adviser.

Throughout the advising process, you'll receive access to resources that help you maximize your potential and succeed in your course work.

1-on-1 Support

for course selection, academic progress, and success skills

Your Network of Support

We're here for you every step of the way.

Academic Advising

Make an advising appointment for assistance with course planning and registration. Learn about our Student Support Services, McNair Scholars Program and Project VITAL.

Academic Services

This is your point of contact for information on course schedules, academic calendars, graduation process and more.

Disability Support Services

We're committed to providing equal access and opportunities to qualified students with disabilities.

Academic Resources

 

The Writing Center

In addition to one-on-one appointments, we host workshops, social events and collaborative space to help you develop your writing.

Math Center

The Math Center is a state-of-the-art space for you to work on mathematical concepts and problem solving with peers.

Pearson Library

Need help using the library? Our librarians are available to assist with accessing online journals, course reserves, interlibrary loans and more.
